```asm
0x1A9683  C3                           retn
0x1A9684  E8 3F 5E 31 01               call    __stack_chk_fail
```

</details>

## 5. Interpretation rules

1. A direct call/xref to an imported NGS2 symbol is strong evidence of an API call site.
2. A direct stack write of a parameter ID immediately before `VoiceControl` is evidence of that parameter builder; payload fields still need interpretation.
3. A function-wide immediate or a constant in a grouped signature is only a candidate until tied to the parameter pointer passed at that call.
4. A register backtrace is bounded and not path-sensitive. Values crossing branches, calls, or aliases may remain unresolved.
5. Callback candidates require tracing the assigned function pointer through indirect call sites and validating calling convention / lifetime.
